annotations.text:
Click the rail on the left. Overview, Validator, Layout Rules, Build, Update Preview and Runtime Monitor are all drawn.

The rail is the change: it is not a menu, it is the pipeline, and its colour is where content actually stops today. "What is broken" is answered before you click anything.

Closed — see Decisions & build order:
· Diagnostics: cut Assets + Performance, re-aim Scopes as Asset Lifetime.
· Profiles: conformance view, not a second editor.
· Ctrl+K: yes, built last.

Colours resolve from --unity-colors-* so the window follows the Editor skin. Spacing, radii and the 150px key column are lifted from the package's existing USS. USS has no grid, no ::before, no box-shadow, no rem and no media queries — nothing here needs them.
